description:
Links to the site and the places it should be listed. Free: another site's links are research_backlinks.
view:
- ledger(limit?): Every backlink Sightkick watches: source (outreach, directory, found, manual), type (dofollow, nofollow, ugc, sponsored, mention) and verdict (live, dropped, checking, not_found).
- profile: The site's own link profile from its weekly check: domain rating, links, referring sites and what the last check found (the linking pages are the ledger).
- mentions: Pages naming the brand without a link: easy links to ask for.
- directories(status?): The directories this business belongs on, ranked by how often AI answers cite them: status, where to list, cost, the submit page, the fields pre-written. Submit a listing yourself with the kit, as each directory's own rules allow, then mark it with update_backlinks directory.
- kit: The listing kit the directories' fields come from.
name: get_backlinks
title: Get backlinks
